database.name: HefnoPlant Insecticides & Acaricides Active Ingredients Database
database.description: Scientific database of agricultural and public-health insecticide & acaricide active ingredients, classified by IRAC mode-of-action groups, with target pest/mite relationships, crops, application data, resistance management, and rotation spray programs. Active-ingredient-first: no commercial/trade product names, brands, or prices are included.
database.scope: Insecticides, acaricides, and insect-targeting biological/fumigant control substances (agricultural + public-health vector/pest control). Rodenticides, nematicides, herbicides, and fungicides are excluded from this file.
